instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: As a major event venue and catering provider, Cipher manages complex logistics across multiple high-profile venues, requiring deep integration between sales, operations, and client management. The company hosts 500+ events annually for corporate clients and weddings, necessitating robust, scalable solutions for CRM, floor planning, and inventory tracking. This matrix structure makes achieving enterprise-wide technological alignment a significant operational challenge.
answers.pastInitiatives: We piloted a cloud-based project management tool last year, but adoption was inconsistent across teams and we ultimately reverted to spreadsheets and email for most project tracking. The experience highlighted that tool adoption requires more structured change management than we initially planned for.
answers.strategicGoals: Customer retention has declined from 92% to 84% over the past 18 months, primarily among our mid-tier and enterprise segments. Exit interviews consistently cite product stagnation and poor digital self-service tools as reasons for leaving. We need to urgently modernize our customer-facing technology and proactively address the specific pain points driving churn before the trend becomes irreversible.
answers.teamSize: Innovation is decentralized across business units, each with its own innovation lead and dedicated resources, coordinated by a group-level Chief Innovation Officer. The total innovation workforce is approximately 100 people across the organization. A group innovation fund of €5M annually is allocated competitively — business units pitch for funding against clear innovation KPIs including revenue from new products and process efficiency gains.
answers.additionalContext: We underwent a significant restructuring 6 months ago, consolidating 5 business units into 3 and reducing headcount by 12%. The remaining teams are stretched thin managing the same workload with fewer people. Morale has stabilized but is still recovering. Any innovation initiative must be achievable without adding burden to already-overloaded teams and should visibly improve their daily work experience.

opportunities.title: CRM Module Enhancement for Predictive Retention
opportunities.rationale: Focus on incremental improvements to the existing CRM software to offer personalized event recommendations and proactive retention alerts for mid-tier clients.

first_actions: Conduct a gap analysis of current CRM features against competitor offerings.
Develop a prioritized backlog of 3 high-value incremental feature requests.
Allocate budget to third-party integration testing.
resources_needed: Internal sales team time for feedback cycles
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase in mid-tier customer retention rate from 84% to 87% within one year.
milestones: Q3: Finalize feature scope and design mockups
Q4: Beta launch of the enhanced CRM module with a controlled user group

opportunities.title: Automated Floor Plan Optimization Tool
opportunities.rationale: Invest in a low-risk tool to optimize event space utilization and minimize setup time, providing immediate operational efficiency gains.

first_actions: Identify the most time-consuming manual floor plan creation process.
Select a SaaS solution with existing API compatibility for integration.
Run a pilot program in one satellite venue.
resources_needed: €75,000 for software licensing and internal development hours
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in average setup time per event by 15% within six months.
milestones: Q3: Tool selection and sandbox environment setup
Q4: Full deployment across all three satellite venues

opportunities.title: Hyper-Personalized AI Event Experience Engine (Bold)
opportunities.rationale: Develop a bold, long-term initiative to leverage AI and machine learning to dynamically suggest venue packages, catering menus, and schedule optimizations for individual high-value clients.

first_actions: Establish a small cross-functional 'Blue Sky' team with deep tech expertise.
Develop a proof-of-concept model using existing historical customer data.
Prepare a detailed 3-year roadmap justifying the high initial investment.
resources_needed: €500,000 for specialized AI talent and core R&D infrastructure
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve a 10% increase in average transaction value through personalized upselling.
milestones: Year 1: Proof of Concept and technical validation
Year 2: Limited market pilot rollout (conservative scaling)

next_steps.action: Formalize the priority roadmap for Q3/Q4 focused on CRM enhancement and floor plan automation.
Secure approval from the formal committee to allocate €75,000 for the automated floor plan pilot project.
Conduct internal workshops focused on 'structured change management' training to address past adoption failures.

key_weaknesses: Reliance on informal processes which leads to inconsistent technology adoption and poor ROI modeling.
Decentralized innovation efforts lacking standardized governance, resulting in resource duplication across business units.
Significant cultural resistance to adopting new technologies due to a history of failed pilot programs without adequate change management.
Stretched operational capacity following the recent restructuring, limiting resources available for non-essential long-term R&D.
